prompt:
Style: atmospheric digital painting for a 2D side-scrolling adventure game, in the painterly manner of hand-painted 2D platformer and exploration game backgrounds of the 2010s and 2020s. Painted with large soft digital brushes and a few textured brushes: soft edges, visible brush texture, big simplified shapes, little fine detail, no outlines. Strong aerial perspective in clearly separated depth planes: the far distance dissolves into luminous haze, the middle ground has muted, low-contrast values, the nearest objects are darker and more saturated. Thin veils of mist lie between the planes and on the water. The light sources glow with soft halos: the lit cottage window, the iron lantern and the lighthouse lamp. Limited palette: deep teal, slate blue and dusty violet for shadows and distance, warm amber and orange only for the horizon band and the lights. Calm, quiet, slightly melancholic mood. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a postcard, not an oil painting with thick impasto, not a cartoon with ink outlines.
Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Composition for a side-scrolling game level: strict side view at eye level, flat horizon at 45 % of the image height. The stone quay runs horizontally across the full width as a flat walkable ledge; its top surface lies at about 80 % of the image height and its front wall goes down to the bottom edge. The cottage stands on the quay in the left third, with the barrels, crates, rope coil and lantern post next to it; the middle and right part of the quay stays empty. Behind the quay, in the middle, the short wooden jetty reaches into the water with the two boats. The rocky headland rises from the sea further back on the right; the lighthouse stands at about 80 % of the width, its top at about 18 % of the image height. The lighthouse lamp is only a small glowing spot without any beam, and there is no smoke from the chimney and there are no birds: beam, smoke and birds are animated separately in the game.
Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
